items.title_es: Solana Debuts Institutional Settlement Standard With J.P. Morgan Input

items.title: Strive Adds $169M Bitcoin in Its Biggest Buy in Four Months
items.summary: The Nasdaq-listed bitcoin treasury company, co-founded by Vivek Ramaswamy, paid roughly $169 million for 2,000 coins last week and now holds 29,462 BTC.
items.title_es: Strive Adds $169M Bitcoin in Its Biggest Buy in Four Months

items.title: DeFi Development Corp Adds $3 Million in Solana as SOL Buys Slow
items.summary: Nasdaq-listed DeFi Development Corp's latest SEC filing shows its Solana stash grew 1%, to about 2.56 million SOL and SOL equivalents—roughly half the prior week's gain and well below mid-September's pace.
items.title_es: DeFi Development Corp Adds $3 Million in Solana as SOL Buys Slow

items.title: A Florida Woman Used Claude as a Diary. An Anthropic Employee Read It and Reported It to Police
items.summary: Investigators say a Bonita Springs woman's Claude "diary" tripped Anthropic's safety filters. A human review team sent it to police, and Anthropic's own terms allow exactly that.
items.title_es: A Florida Woman Used Claude as a Diary. An Anthropic Employee Read It and Reported It to Police

items.title: Treasury withdraws crypto mixing rule, citing concerns over ‘chilling effect on legitimate activity’
items.summary: FinCEN is withdrawing a proposal that would've designated crypto mixing a "primary money laundering concern" under the PATRIOT Act.
items.title_es: Treasury withdraws crypto mixing rule, citing concerns over ‘chilling effect on legitimate activity’

items.title: Umia raises $6.1 million at $18 million FDV to help crypto projects launch tokens
items.summary: Umia raised $6.11 million through a seven-day auction of its UMIA token, with ten funds and nearly 700 individual bidders taking part.
items.title_es: Umia raises $6.1 million at $18 million FDV to help crypto projects launch tokens
